response.sql: WITH team_avg AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(l * 1.0 / g) AS avg_ratio FROM manager_half WHERE g > 53 GROUP BY team_id) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS result FROM team_avg;

assumptions.assumption: "Each team" means each team_id, pooled across all years and leagues in manager_half. Rows with NULL l or NULL g produce a NULL ratio, which AVG ignores. The multiplication by 1.0 avoids integer division.

alternatives.interpretation: Each team-season is a separate team: group by team_id and year, average the l/g ratios within each team-season, then average those values across all team-seasons.
alternatives.sql: WITH team_year_avg AS (SELECT team_id, year, AVG(l * 1.0 / g) AS avg_ratio FROM manager_half WHERE g > 53 GROUP BY team_id, year) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS result FROM team_year_avg;
